scope: billing, fiscal 54-fz, cashier, shifts, payments, family balance, dms, installment

findings.description: 54-FZ modal was announcing false OFD fiscalization and passing 0.00 ₽ checks to thermal KKT, causing hardware error 0x2A/0x48 on 100% warranty treatments.
findings.resolution: Intercepted receiptToFiscalize.totalRub <= 0 and isWarrantyZeroAct: issued internal warranty act (АКТ-ГАР-...), switched tab to 'act', notified with toast, zero thermal print call.

findings.description: Hardcoded &s=${payments.totalRub}.00 was causing broken float formatting (e.g. 1250.5.00) in OFD URLs, and lacked warranty zero act support.
findings.resolution: Adopted kopecksToNumericString(payments.totalKopecks), integrated computeFpd54Fz for deterministic fiscal sign, set isWarrantyZeroAct: true and empty ofdUrl for 0 kop.

findings.description: POST /api/fiscal/receipts was dispatching 0 kopeck payloads to physical KKT hardware instead of generating internal warranty acts.
findings.resolution: Added interception in LanKktDriverService and route handler: creates internal warranty act in fiscalReceiptQueue with status 'printed', receiptType 'warranty_act', returns isWarrantyZeroAct: true without KKT hardware dispatch.

findings.description: Mandate 8e/8n compliance verified: INN for physical persons paying by cash/card is 100% non-blocking (isValid: true, isRequired: false).
All financial calculations (split payments, advance offsets, family wallets, change) operate with integer kopecks without float drift.
